lines.gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਈਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: teerath naaeeai sukh phal paaeeai mail na laagai kaaee ||
lines.translation: We bathe at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, and obtain the fruits of peace; not even an iota of filth sticks to us.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੋਰਖ ਪੂਤੁ ਲੋਹਾਰੀਪਾ ਬੋਲੈ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਸਾਈ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: gorakh poot lohaareepaa bolai jog jugat bidh saaee ||7||
lines.translation: Luhaareepaa, the disciple of Gorakh says, this is the Way of Yoga." ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਾਟੀ ਬਾਟੀ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਪਰ ਘਰਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਨ ਡੋੁਲਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: haatee baatee need na aavai par ghar chit na doulaaee ||
lines.translation: In the stores and on the road, do not sleep; do not let your consciousness covet anyone else's home.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮਨੁ ਟੇਕ ਨ ਟਿਕਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਭੂਖ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin naavai man tek na tikaee naanak bhookh na jaaee ||
lines.translation: Without the Name, the mind has no firm support; O Nanak, this hunger never departs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਾਟੁ ਪਟਣੁ ਘਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: haat patan ghar guroo dikhaaiaa sahaje sach vaapaaro ||
lines.translation: The Guru has revealed the stores and the city within the home of my own heart, where I intuitively carry on the true trade.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੰਡਿਤ ਨਿਦ੍ਰਾ ਅਲਪ ਅਹਾਰੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: kha(n)dit nidraa alap ahaara(n) naanak tat beechaaro ||8||
lines.translation: Sleep little, and eat little; O Nanak, this is the essence of wisdom. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਖ ਕਰਹੁ ਜੋਗਿੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਝੋਲੀ ਖਿੰਥਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: darasan bhekh karahu jogi(n)draa mu(n)draa jholee khi(n)thaa ||
lines.translation: "Wear the robes of the sect of Yogis who follow Gorakh; put on the ear-rings, begging wallet and patched coat.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਰਹ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਸਰੇਵਹੁ ਖਟੁ ਦਰਸਨ ਇਕ ਪੰਥਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: baarah a(n)tar ek sarevahu khat darasan ik pa(n)thaa ||
lines.translation: Among the twelve schools of Yoga, ours is the highest; among the six schools of philosophy, ours is the best path.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਪੁਰਖਾ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਚੋਟ ਨ ਖਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: in bidh man samajhaaeeai purakhaa baahuR chot na khaaeeai ||
lines.translation: This is the way to instruct the mind, so you will never suffer beatings again."

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਇਵ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: naanak bolai guramukh boojhai jog jugat iv paaeeai ||9||
lines.translation: Nanak speaks: the Gurmukh understands; this is the way that Yoga is attained. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਮੁਦ੍ਰਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar sabad nira(n)tar mudraa haumai mamataa door karee ||
lines.translation: Let constant absorption in the Word of the Shabad deep within be your ear-rings; eradicate egotism and attachment.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁ ਸਮਝ ਪਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam krodh aha(n)kaar nivaarai gur kai sabad s samajh paree ||
lines.translation: Discard sexual desire, anger and egotism, and through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, attain true understanding.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਿੰਥਾ ਝੋਲੀ ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾਰੈ ਏਕੁ ਹਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: khi(n)thaa jholee bharipur rahiaa naanak taarai ek haree ||
lines.translation: For your patched coat and begging bowl, see the Lord God pervading and permeating everywhere; O Nanak, the One Lord will carry you across.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਾਚੀ ਨਾਈ ਪਰਖੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ ਖਰੀ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: saachaa saahib saachee naaee parakhai gur kee baat kharee ||10||
lines.translation: True is our Lord and Master, and True is His Name. Analyze it, and you shall find the Word of the Guru to be True. ||10||
Let your mind turn away in detachment from the world, and let this be your begging bowl. Let the lessons of the five elements be your cap.
Let the body be your meditation mat, and the mind your loin cloth.
Let truth, contentment and self-discipline be your companions.
O Nanak, the Gurmukh dwells on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਗੁਪਤਾ ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਮੁਕਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kavan s gupataa kavan s mukataa ||
lines.translation: "Who is hidden? Who is liberated?
Who is united, inwardly and outwardly?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਆਵੈ ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kavan s aavai kavan s jaai ||
lines.translation: Who comes, and who goes?
Who is permeating and pervading the three worlds?" ||12||
He is hidden within each and every heart. The Gurmukh is liberated.
Through the Word of the Shabad, one is united, inwardly and outwardly.
The self-willed manmukh perishes, and comes and goes.
O Nanak, the Gurmukh merges in Truth. ||13||
"How is one placed in bondage, and consumed by the serpent of Maya?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਖੋਇਆ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਲਾਧਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiu kar khoiaa kiu kar laadhaa ||
lines.translation: How does one lose, and how does one gain?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiu kar niramal kiu kar a(n)dhiaaraa ||
lines.translation: How does one become immaculate and pure? How is the darkness of ignorance removed?

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ਸੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: ihu tat beechaarai s guroo hamaaraa ||14||
lines.translation: One who understands this essence of reality is our Guru." ||14||
Man is bound by evil-mindedness, and consumed by Maya, the serpent.
The self-willed manmukh loses, and the Gurmukh gains.
Meeting the True Guru, darkness is dispelled.
O Nanak, eradicating egotism, one merges in the Lord. ||15||
Focused deep within, in perfect absorption,

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਡੈ ਨ ਹੰਸਾ ਪੜੈ ਨ ਕੰਧੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: udai na ha(n)saa paRai na ka(n)dh ||
lines.translation: the soul-swan does not fly away, and the body-wall does not collapse.
Then, one knows that his true home is in the cave of intuitive poise.
O Nanak, the True Lord loves those who are truthful. ||16||
"Why have you left your house and become a wandering Udaasee?
Why have you adopted these religious robes?
What merchandise do you trade?
How will you carry others across with you?" ||17||
I became a wandering Udaasee, searching for the Gurmukhs.
I have adopted these robes seeking the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.
I trade in the merchandise of Truth.
O Nanak, as Gurmukh, I carry others across. ||18||
"How have you changed the course of your life?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਤੁਝੁ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaahe kau tujh ihu man laaiaa ||
lines.translation: With what have you linked your mind?
